title: 6 Things Walking Humbly Actually Costs a Godly Man
caption:
6 things walking humbly actually costs a godly man.

Micah 6:8 never promised it would feel humble.

1. The apology with no "but" attached.
2. The credit he lets someone else take.
3. The correction he receives without defending himself first.
4. The win he doesn't post.
5. The room he lets someone else lead.
6. The mercy he asks for the same way he needs it.

He walks humbly with his God, not performs it for an audience.
